title: Determination of Hardness of Water Using EDTA Titration
subtitle: Complexometric Titration with Eriochrome Black T (EBT) Indicator

phases.name: Phase 1: Preparation of Standard EDTA Solution
phases.objective: Weigh disodium salt of EDTA accurately, transfer to a 250 mL volumetric flask, dissolve and make up to the mark with ion-exchange water to calculate exact EDTA molarity.

steps.title: Weigh Bottle + EDTA Salt
steps.instruction: Weigh the weighing bottle containing EDTA disodium salt on the electronic balance and record W1 (g).

steps.title: Transfer EDTA Salt
steps.instruction: Carefully transfer the EDTA crystals through the funnel into the 250 mL volumetric flask.

steps.title: Reweigh Empty Bottle
steps.instruction: Reweigh the empty bottle on the balance to record W2 (g) and determine transferred mass W = W1 - W2.

steps.title: Wash Funnel with Water
steps.instruction: Pour ion-exchange water through the funnel to wash all EDTA crystals into the flask, then remove funnel.

steps.title: Dissolve EDTA Crystals
steps.instruction: Swirl the volumetric flask gently to dissolve the EDTA crystals completely in ion-exchange water.

steps.title: Make Up to 250 mL Mark
steps.instruction: Add ion-exchange water until the lower meniscus reaches the 250 mL graduation mark on the neck.

steps.title: Stopper & Mix by Inversion
steps.instruction: Stopper the volumetric flask and invert several times to obtain a completely homogeneous standard solution.

steps.title: Calculate EDTA Molarity
steps.instruction: Calculate standard EDTA molarity: M = (Weight of EDTA × 4) / 372.24.

phases.name: Phase 2: Determination of Total Hardness
phases.objective: Titrate 25 mL of water sample against prepared standard EDTA solution using NH3-NH4Cl buffer and pinch of EBT indicator to determine total hardness in ppm of CaCO3.

steps.title: Fill Burette with EDTA
steps.instruction: Fill the burette with the prepared standard EDTA solution up to the 0.00 mL mark.

steps.title: Pipette 25 mL Water Sample
steps.instruction: Pipette exactly 25.0 mL of the given water sample into a clean 250 mL conical flask.

steps.title: Add 3 mL NH3-NH4Cl Buffer
steps.instruction: Add 3.0 mL of NH3-NH4Cl buffer solution to maintain the pH at 10 for complexation.

steps.title: Add Pinch of EBT
steps.instruction: Add a pinch of Eriochrome Black-T indicator. The solution turns wine-red due to metal-indicator complex.

steps.title: Place Conical Flask
steps.instruction: Place the conical flask on the white porcelain contrast tile beneath the burette tip.

steps.title: Titrate with EDTA
steps.instruction: Open the stopcock to titrate with EDTA. Swirl continuously until the solution changes from wine red to clear blue.

steps.title: Record Burette Reading
steps.instruction: Close stopcock and record reading. Repeat trials to obtain an agreeable/concordant burette reading.

steps.title: Calculate Total Hardness
steps.instruction: Calculate total hardness in ppm of CaCO3 using (MV)Hard Water = (MV)EDTA.
